subject.title: [Bug] Flaky session token validation on clock skew across clustered nodes

question: Should OpenClaw accept future-dated peer or device credentials within a tolerance window, and if so, which authenticated token contract owns that policy?
rationale: The requested change deliberately relaxes token-time validation, but the report does not identify the real verifier or establish the replay and expiry contract that a tolerance would modify.

options.title: Require a concrete reproduction first
options.body: Ask for current version, deployment topology, token class, timestamps, and redacted gateway logs before selecting any clock-skew behavior.

options.title: Define a bounded verifier policy
options.body: If a real clustered-token contract is confirmed, document a narrowly scoped tolerance and its security constraints in the owner path.

recommendation.title: Require a concrete reproduction first
recommendation.body: Ask for current version, deployment topology, token class, timestamps, and redacted gateway logs before selecting any clock-skew behavior.
